common_observer_instructions: You are an observer predicting a human participant's numeric choice, given the supplied side and one order. This is a behavioral forecast, not advice or profit maximization. Use the supplied historical facts and recorded rules unchanged; The current diagnostic grid differs from the historical integer-dollar interface. One diagnostic order is being described; although the original interface allows up to five paper orders, this numeric probe conditions on one. Predict the human numeric choice from the supplied complete candidate values. Do not infer the participant's direction; the side is supplied for this diagnostic. Do not use target orders, target final profit, or answer keys. Choose exactly one complete dollar price on the full $5 grid; this is conditional on the chosen side and quantity.
economic_definitions_added_only_in_rules: own_p is revenue per unit of this participant's own demand D served, not an order limit or market price. Other participants have different private p. The wholesale cost of Q was incurred before D was revealed. Units neither used to serve own demand nor sold expire at round end with no salvage value. Orders are blind limits: a BUY limit is the maximum acceptable unit price; a SELL limit is the minimum. Bids rank highest first and asks lowest first. Fills may be partial or zero. All fills in a market trade at one uniform price: the midpoint of the last matched bid and ask. An order's fill price can differ from its limit; a limit can affect the clearing price when marginal. Historical order prices are submitted limits, not realized prices. These definitions describe the rules, not a recommended action.
decoder: top3, raw probability >= 0.03, paired old price-stage draw; no fallback
protocol: original request identical to parent; rules adds only public_instructions.economic_definitions
fixed: 8 supplied-SELL people, 3-/10-round own history, target formal11, old quantities, 2 repeats, contemporaneous arms; 64 requests
privacy: Generic prompt and metadata only; private state, human orders, wire responses and singleton/complement metrics not distributed.
